Collection day : Tuesday Hours of collection: 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. Deposit hours : Take out containers between 7 p.m. the day before and 7 a.m. the day of collection Containers accepted: -Wheeled bin with a capacity of no more than 360 litres, closed by a lid and with a European-style lifting system. -1 to 2 m3 container, closed by a lid and can be emptied by rear loading. -Garbage can with a capacity of not more than 150 liters closed by a lid and equipped with handles whose weight does not exceed 25 kg when filled. -Closed opaque plastic bag with a capacity of at least 50 liters and no more than 150 liters whose weight does not exceed 25 kg when filled. -Household waste may also be tied in bundles of a maximum of 50 cm in diameter, a length of no more than 1 m and a weight not exceeding 25 kg. When there is a cycle path in front of your address: only waste placed on the median or the hatched area will be collected (except during the winter period from November 16 to March 31 for three-season bike paths) .
